product.name: Confidential Computing Platform
product.description: A confidential computing platform for protecting data and applications in use by isolating critical processes in secure enclaves and managing trusted execution environments across clouds and on-prem environments.
product.positioning: A control plane for confidential computing across clouds and environments that helps enterprises secure sensitive data and AI workloads while they are being processed.

features_and_capabilities.name: Secure enclaves for data in use
features_and_capabilities.description: Protects data and applications while they are being processed by isolating critical processes in secure enclaves and keeping data encrypted at runtime.
features_and_capabilities.how_it_works: Uses hardware-based trusted execution environments to isolate data and code during processing.
features_and_capabilities.customer_benefit: Reduces unauthorized access to sensitive data even if compute infrastructure is compromised.

features_and_capabilities.name: Unified control plane
features_and_capabilities.description: Provides a single control plane to configure, attest, and monitor the confidential computing stack across CPUs and GPUs.
features_and_capabilities.how_it_works: Centralizes management of trusted execution environments and secure enclaves.
features_and_capabilities.customer_benefit: Simplifies operations across confidential computing environments at scale.

features_and_capabilities.name: Attestation verification and policy enforcement
features_and_capabilities.description: Verifies firmware and software integrity and enforces policies before secure key release.
features_and_capabilities.how_it_works: Uses composite attestation across CPU and GPU and signals secure key release only after verification.
features_and_capabilities.customer_benefit: Ensures workloads run only in trusted environments.

features_and_capabilities.name: Cross-cloud confidential computing control plane
features_and_capabilities.description: Supports confidential computing across clouds and environments rather than a single cloud ecosystem.
features_and_capabilities.customer_benefit: Lets organizations manage confidential computing consistently across hybrid and multicloud environments.

features_and_capabilities.name: Confidential AI protection
features_and_capabilities.description: Protects data, AI models, and model weights inside trusted execution environments.
features_and_capabilities.customer_benefit: Helps organizations run AI workloads without exposing sensitive data or models.

differentiators: Acts as a control plane for confidential computing across clouds and environments, not just infrastructure availability in one cloud ecosystem.
Combines attestation verification, policy enforcement, and secure key release to ensure workloads run only in trusted environments.
Provides composite attestation across CPU and GPU from a unified control plane.

customer.target_customer: Enterprises, especially organizations in highly regulated industries that handle sensitive, personal, or regulated data across hybrid multicloud environments.
buyers: Head of Data Security and Compliance
users: ML engineers running confidential AI workloads
problems: Data is most exposed while it is being processed because encryption at rest and in transit leaves a blind spot for data in use.
Administrators, cloud operators, insiders, or compromised systems may access sensitive data during processing.
Managing secure enclaves and policies at scale adds operational complexity.
Organizations need to meet privacy, compliance, and data sovereignty requirements while using sensitive data and AI workloads.
use_cases: Protecting sensitive data and applications in use.
Securing healthcare AI and enabling secure healthcare data collaboration.
Protecting data in use for machine learning models.
Securing blockchain, crypto wallets, and NFTs.
desired_outcomes: Maintain the privacy and compliance of sensitive and regulated data.
Reduce the risk of unauthorized access to data and AI models during active use.
Simplify operations for confidential computing environments.
Accelerate digital transformation and secure innovation with sensitive data.
existing_alternatives: Encryption at rest and in transit without protection for data in use.
Azure Confidential Computing infrastructure within the Azure ecosystem.
Depending on a cloud provider's limited data security controls.

customer_stories: BeeKeeperAI uses Fortanix Confidential Computing to accelerate the development and deployment of healthcare AI while keeping sensitive data in a secure cloud environment.
Goldman Sachs worked with Fortanix on data migration initiatives that required robust encryption to comply with data privacy and security regulations.
company_expertise: Fortanix describes itself as a pioneer in Confidential Computing.
The team cites 100+ security patents, 30+ papers in top conferences, and presenters at USENIX, CCC, and Blackhat.
product_evidence: Fortanix says its platform encrypts data in use across cloud applications, storage, and on-prem environments by isolating critical processes in a secure enclave.
Fortanix says Confidential Computing Manager can manage secure enclaves, verify firmware and software integrity, and protect data and AI models inside trusted execution environments.
proprietary_insights_or_examples: Fortanix states that data is most exposed when it is being processed and positions confidential computing as solving the blind spot left by encryption at rest and in transit.

writing_style: Uses technical security terminology such as secure enclaves, trusted execution environments, attestation, and zero-trust architecture
